requirements: Create unique per-environment cgroup and fixed-capacity scratch image before launcher start
Never delegate cgroup management to guest code
Record actual parent host resource overhead and reserve capacity before guest admission
Observe cgroup.events populated=0 before deletion; no inference from kill request success
Stop launcher, VM and all descendants before wiping disposable app disk/credentials
All guest/launcher cgroups must remain descendants of system.slice/forge-host-supervisor.service so systemd KillMode=control-group fences them on supervisor exit
Place the supervisor in a separate child cgroup before enabling domain controllers; verify the no-internal-process constraint on the selected systemd/kernel
Never move microVMs outside the supervisor unit subtree or claim KillMode covers unrelated cgroups
Host pids.max bounds VMM threads; enforcing 512 guest app processes additionally requires trusted guest-side process limits, which are not implemented here
